Kamera & Objektiv-Ständer - SONY A7IV - SIGMA 24-70 Art

https://makerworld.com/de/models/387776-camera-lens-stand-sony-a7iv-sigma-24-70-art#profileId-288401

Crafted with precision, this custom-designed stand is tailored to accommodate the Sony A7IV camera paired with a Sigma 24-70 Art lens, ensuring optimal support and protection for the lens mount during periods of non-use. Featuring an integrated Arca Swiss connection, the stand is designed to work seamlessly with the Peak Design capture clip, allowing for secure attachment to the camera body.

Perfect for photographers seeking to preserve the integrity of their gear while not in active use.

 

* Sony A7IV (will work with other bodies)
* Sigma 24-70 Art
* Peak Design Capture Clip V3

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: 0.15mm layer, 3 walls, 15% infill
- Filament: PLA (#00AE42)
